versions.name: Camp Sol Mayer
versions.address: 299 Camp Sol Mayer Rd, Menard, TX 76859
versions.summary: The Texas Southwest Council's long-term camp along the San Saba River near Menard in west Texas, with cabins, a dining hall, and a fishing pier, hosting camporees, Cub camps, and winter camp for units through the year.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Texas Southwest Council camp page (scoutingtsc.org), which lists current camporees, Cub camp, and winter camp at the property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; the rural address did not resolve in the US Census geocoder); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camp page and current event listings; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively from the stated Cub camp and multi-unit camping uses; features unsurveyed.
